description: R3 item 1: repeated deployment splits. B2T: day-stratified random fit-A (1/4) / clean calibration (1/4) / test (1/2) of all main-vocabulary trials; pipeline fitted on fit-A only (paper recipe pipe.fit(A, A)); reused calibration = fit-A. sEMG: participant-stratified random fit-A (1/2) / fit-B1 policy grid (1/4) / fit-B2 clean calibration (1/4) of the fit sentences; fixed test; reused calibration = fit-B1. Frame temperature snapped to 0.02 (B2T) / 0.01 (sEMG) to share decodes. Settings fixed before the first run.
selective_methods: SGR (Geifman & El-Yaniv 2017, Alg. 1, exact binomial bound, Bonferroni over ceil(log2 m) steps)
LTT on error among commits (exact binomial conditional on commits, Bonferroni over lambda grid 0.05..1.00 step 0.05)
